recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中大量小至中型淋巴樣細胞，核圓、核質比極高、染色質均勻細緻而不呈芽細胞樣、幾乎無核仁與細胞質，與成熟中的顆粒球系及紅血球系細胞混雜；在移植後第 30 天再生期，這是骨髓 hematogones 增生。
features: Numerous small-to-intermediate lymphoid cells with very high N:C ratio and scant rim of cytoplasm
Round to slightly indented nuclei with homogeneous, smudged-dense chromatin and no or inconspicuous nucleoli
Size spectrum from small lymphocyte to slightly larger cells, lacking a monotonous blast population
Admixed maturing myeloid precursors (myelocytes, metamyelocytes, band/segmented neutrophils) and a monocyte
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate shows a marked increase in small-to-intermediate lymphoid cells with round to slightly indented nuclei, homogeneous condensed chromatin, absent or inconspicuous nucleoli and scant cytoplasm, forming a continuous spectrum in size. These are admixed with orderly maturing granulocytic precursors and occasional monocytes, without a discrete population of large blasts. In a day-30 post-allogeneic transplant marrow, findings are consistent with regenerative hematogone hyperplasia; flow cytometry showing a normal maturational continuum of CD34/CD10/CD20 expression without aberrancies confirms benignity.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts form a monotonous population with finer chromatin and nucleoli, and by flow show maturation arrest with aberrant antigen expression (e.g., CD58 bright, CD38 dim, myeloid antigens) instead of a continuum.

ddx.dx: Mature small B-cell lymphoma involving marrow
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells are CD34/CD10/TdT negative with surface light-chain restriction and usually form interstitial or nodular aggregates.
Mature lymphocytes have more cytoplasm and clumped chromatin and are CD3+ rather than TdT/CD10+ B-cell precursors.
Tumor cells form cohesive clumps or rosettes and are CD45 negative.
